name: BeamLines
description: Evenly spaced vertical guide lines with glowing light beams sweeping down each one at staggered, deterministic speeds, rendered with CSS transforms only.
a11yNotes: The beam field is aria-hidden and non-interactive; children render in a normal content layer. Timings use a seeded rand(n) for hydration-safe markup. prefers-reduced-motion stops the sweep and parks each beam mid-line.

propsApi.name: beamColor
propsApi.description: Color of the travelling beam and its glow.

propsApi.name: speed
propsApi.description: Speed multiplier; base sweep time is 2.5-4.5s divided by this value.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Foreground content centered above the beams.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.
